# Copilot instructions for the Buderus case repository

**Read `AGENTS.md` in the repository root first.** It holds the shared rules for every AI tool in this repository. Then read `CASE.md` for the assignment and its requirements.

## Where things are

- Visual rules: `DESIGN.md`
- Procedures: `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (Copilot reads this folder as well)
- Business case figures and their sources: `analysis/business-case.md`
- Frameworks to apply: `context/frameworks.md`

## Copilot-specific notes

- When drafting paper text in Word with Microsoft 365 Copilot, keep the position-paper structure from `context/programme.md`.
- Never fill in pilot results: the case does not provide them.
